verdict.rationale: Asking whether a coding-agent desktop app offers official SDKs is a fair question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents an official SDK for building against Omnirush. The `pnpm --filter @omnirush/desktop dev` command only runs the app from source. Adding your own OpenAI or Anthropic keys and plugging in MCP servers are adjacent features, not an SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
